learning.title: Live browser locale fixtures must set the saved user preference
learning.trigger: Authenticated RTL browser case remains English after navigator.languages selects ar-XB.
learning.rule: Saved user preferences override browser language after sign-in. Configure the isolated fixture through the real userPreferences GET/PATCH API with current casVersion before reloading. Serialize cases that mutate the same principal's account-wide locale; each case sets its own locale. Preserve RTL assertions and existing timeouts.
learning.verification: Run the live artifact retrieval and review cases through tests/e2e/task-artifact-linked-read_test.ts. Both desktop and mobile must pass against the owned PostgreSQL-backed API.
